Description:
We have detected intermittent new service deployment failures from console.vultr.com and the Vultr API
What you might experience:

Inability to deploy
Subscriptions reporting down in console.vultr.com - these subscriptions are up and functional on hosts
Inability to access our API

Our engineering teams are actively engaged in identifying and working to resolve the issue

Event Type: Network Upgrade

We are performing system changes in the Amsterdam location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-08-12 22:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-13 03:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to maintain our ideal hosting environment. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact; however, Amsterdam instances may be unreachable for some, or all, of the scheduled maintenance window as we perform network, firmware, or host upgrades.

Event Type: Storage Cluster Upgrade
Start Time: 2026-08-06 13:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-06 15:00:00 UTC

Our Cloud Storage team will be performing maintenance to storage located in Atlanta. During this maintenance window, creating, attaching, resizing, and deletion of storage and storage gateways may be unavailable. Vultr Filesystem and storage gateways subscriptions may notice brief service interruptions as they are shifted to new hosts.

The storage team will monitor cluster health, node status, and workload recovery throughout the maintenance window.

Event Type: Service Degraded Performance and Availability

Our Cloud Storage team is investigating a partial outage scenario with our VFS infrastructure. The following services may be impacted by this event:

- Filesytem creation
- Filesytem deletion
- Attach / Detach to VPS instance
- Accessing Filesystem contents

We are working quickly to restore service to its optimal state.

We are performing system changes in the Johannesburg location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-08-05 22:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-06 04:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to reduce impact to customer infrastructure. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact, however, network reachability to Johannesburg instances may be affected for some, or all, of the scheduled maintenance window as we perform this work. While it’s important to be aware of start and end times of the maintenance window, due to our redundant network architecture, our engineers expect that you may see little to no impact at all while the work is performed.
